purpose: Isolate the early-window normalized shift spike in valid Repair42 by splitting only the frozen Repair41 direct Q_GE06 stage-source correction into its six-row main-source and two-row constraint-source contributions at the original Nt128 factor-1 Radau stages. Preserve all other frozen Repair37 inputs, including the total-source PCHIP baseline, projected p0 and active mask.

controls.baseline: Exact frozen Repair37 total H4 source with Repair07 PCHIP at Nt128 factor-1 Radau stages
controls.projected_p0: Exact frozen Repair37 projected p0, never recomputed
controls.H4_operator: Exact frozen Repair07 GE06/GE07 plus Repair11 Lambda canonical operator
controls.source_target: Only 2Q_GE06_cross, not M1 or other H4 pieces
controls.target_correction: Repair41 direct382/direct763 target minus the saved Repair41 frozen PCHIP target at the same factor-1 stage

correction_definition.MAIN_ONLY: Add direct-minus-PCHIP GE06 correction to six main source rows only; retain frozen PCHIP total constraint source.
correction_definition.CONSTRAINT_ONLY: Add direct-minus-PCHIP GE06 correction to two constraint source rows only; retain frozen PCHIP total main source.
correction_definition.BOTH: Add both GE06 main and constraint corrections, exactly reproducing frozen Repair42 DIRECT382_Q_GE06_ONLY or DIRECT763_Q_GE06_ONLY.
correction_definition.x0: Retain exact frozen PCHIP source and projected p0.
correction_definition.stage_lookup: Exact Repair41 saved factor-1 stage coordinate lookup within existing 1e-13 absolute coordinate tolerance

preregistered_hotspot.purpose: Report the absolute constraint-source displacement divided by frozen Repair37 actual shift backward-error scale at the already identified Repair42 hotspot. This is not a new active-mask or threshold rule.

diagnostic_quantities.full_field_attribution: For each direct resolution, separately compute RMS of the active shift-metric field difference between MAIN_ONLY and frozen Repair42 Q_GE06_ONLY and between CONSTRAINT_ONLY and frozen Repair42 Q_GE06_ONLY. Whichever is closer in RMS explains more of the full normalized-shift field under the one-row-family intervention, without presuming metric additivity.
diagnostic_quantities.per_resolution: Preserve full fields and report all beta and C cases; no threshold-based sample exclusion beyond the original frozen active mask.

diagnostic_routes.QGE06_CONSTRAINT_ROW_FIELD_CLOSER_TO_FUL: All implementation gates pass and CONSTRAINT_ONLY has strictly smaller active-field difference RMS to the frozen Repair42 Q_GE06_ONLY result than MAIN_ONLY for both Nt382 and Nt763.
diagnostic_routes.QGE06_MAIN_ROW_FIELD_CLOSER_TO_FULL: All implementation gates pass and MAIN_ONLY is strictly closer to the frozen Repair42 Q_GE06_ONLY active field than CONSTRAINT_ONLY for both resolutions.
diagnostic_routes.QGE06_MIXED_ROW_SENSITIVITY: All implementation gates pass but the two resolutions do not agree on the closer single-row-family intervention, or ties occur.
diagnostic_routes.IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL: Any frozen parent, stage binding, baseline/full reproduction, projected p0, active mask or finiteness gate fails.

next_step_rule.if_constraint: Freeze result and localize fine-parent versus coarse-total H4 source-constraint/Noether compatibility, including local normalization at the registered hotspot; do not add unrelated source patches.
next_step_rule.if_main: Freeze result and localize the GE06 main-source stage correction, propagated-state/constraint transfer and parent-time resolution.
next_step_rule.if_mixed: Freeze result and localize row-family interaction without claiming one physical component is erroneous.
